# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** 28  <sub>[v2 c10 P49](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c38 P31](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls (Ainslie farm)  <sub>[v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher; aspiring nurse  <sub>[v1 c17 P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Rufus Vane; Lorna Ainslie  <sub>[v2 c11 P11](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0011), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna is a remarkably beautiful young woman with a tall, supple, and graceful figure, milk-white skin, and bright blue eyes. Her most striking feature is her thick, glossy, golden hair, which reaches all the way to her feet when unbound. She often wears simple dresses adorned with a splash of crimson, such as a red silk sash or a red geranium.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c5 P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v3 c33 P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v4 c10 P5](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0005), [v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000), [v4 c33 P8](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0008)_

## Personality

Lorna possesses a deep, proud, and passionate nature that is fiercely loyal to her loved ones. The intense tragedies of her youth left her reserved, guarded, and occasionally prone to bitterness or quiet despair. Beneath her distant exterior, however, she has a rich capacity for joy, a vivid imagination, and a warmth that blossoms in the company of true friends.

_Sources: [v2 c10 P11](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0011), [v2 c11 P11](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0011), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v4 c10 P44](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0044), [v4 c11 P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c12 P8](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0008), [v4 c21 P4](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0004), [v4 c21 P11](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0011)_

- To protect and support her mother at any personal cost  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027)</sub>

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls, experiencing severe poverty and devastating family losses, including the accidental death of her brother Julian and her father's suicide. Highly ambitious, she completed two years of study in one at Regent's Academy to become a teacher, hoping to work her way through college. However, her mother coerced her into marrying Rufus Vane at age sixteen to save their farm from foreclosure. Rufus deserted her shortly after, but when Captain Saul brought back a brain-injured man from Havana, Lorna faithfully cared for him for eleven years, believing him to be Rufus. During this time, she befriended Nell Harcourt, though she initially struggled with secret envy over Nell's happy life. When Dr. Hugh Carrow suggested the man could be cured through surgery, Lorna bravely took him to Montreal, where the operation revealed the man was actually Rufus's cousin, Laurence Vane, and that Rufus had died years earlier in Cuba. Freed from her tragic bond, Lorna returned to Seven Gulls and fell in love with author Adrian Treleaven. They became engaged and planned to marry in the winter before moving to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v2 c10 P11](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0011), [v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v2 c11 P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033), [v2 c11 P34](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0034), [v4 c30 P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032), [v4 c31 P18](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0018), [v4 c33 P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011), [v4 c36 P23](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0023), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr of Seven Gulls  <sub>[v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Witnessed the tragic death of her four-year-old brother, Julian, at age twelve  <sub>[v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's body after he committed suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Regent's Academy and qualified as a first-class teacher  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Forced into an unwanted marriage with Rufus Vane to prevent foreclosure on her home  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Cared for her brain-damaged cousin Laurence Vane for eleven years believing him to be her husband  <sub>[v2 c11 P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033), [v4 c31 P18](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0018), [v4 c33 P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)</sub>
